name: Nikolay Petrushev
strengths: Petrushev slides back in pass protection and uses that 6-6 reach so the rusher has to go the long way.
Petrushev locks on in the run game, drives the defensive tackle inside, then gets up and walls off the linebacker.
Petrushev wears 78 and plays left tackle and right tackle with the same length.
weaknesses: Petrushev still stands up too tall and bends at the waist instead of sitting down — faster rushers can win around him until he plays lower.
comparison: Petrushev comps to Wyatt Milum — same 6-6 frame, long arms, still filling out toward starter weight.
projection: Petrushev should spend Year 1 getting bigger, then rotate in Year 2 and 3. Ceiling is a multi-year SEC starter if the weight comes and he stops playing so tall.
schemeFit: Petrushev fits as a tackle who wins with length first while the weight and pad height catch up.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-10-06 from Hudl sophomore reel (embed 22939035 / 696521776d1a93cef5fc9037), East Lake. Fan copy rewritten in plain language 2026-10-06. Comp size-matched within ~1–2 inches — not a Florida-alum default.
insiderNotes: Petrushev is a 6-6 / 285 East Lake tackle who slides back and uses his length so rushers have to go the long way, then locks on and gets up to the linebacker on runs. He still stands up too tall. Florida offered June 1; Trautwein; two unofficials, latest Sept. 5.

angle: Lead with East Lake 6-6 length + Florida offer heat after FNL.
